author: AR12
body:
Minecraft IGN: AR12

 Reason why temp-ban or ban: Using hacks (Aimbot)
 I would say that the ban is false as i would never use a hack client on any Minecraft server.
 Evidence that the ban was false as you can see clearly see i do not have any hack client in my Minecraft  version folder. Link to image: 
 I was banned as of December 12 2015
 I have not evaded a ban since i only have 1 account
 This is my first time writing up a ban appeal
 Why should i be un-banned:
 My reason is i wasn't hacking in the first place, as another i game i was playing before going the server was CSGO (Counter Strike Gobal Offensive). In CSGO i was working on my flicks, as well my flicks were on point as it always hit the opposing player. When i went on the server my game and mouse sensitivity was quite high, as Minecraft sensitivity was at hyper speed as well my mouse sensitivity through the computer settings were 8/10 of the way to be maxed out. As by combining those to things it seemed/looked like i had aimbot when i really didn't. I am also promising that i will never hack on a Minecraft server ever. 
 As well thank you for taking the time to read this ban appeal.

  Sincerely AR12
